note: Hand-maintained. Rider-confirmed corner-numbering offsets, which outrank the offsets derived from verified hands in gpx-start-finish-alignment.json. Testing-only; not read by the app.

baskerville.mainStraight: 164m straight into Turn 1; the 465m straight the detector picks unaided is the back straight
baskerville.note: Was offset 2 on the 8-corner numbering. Review now yields 7 corners, so the same main straight is offset 1.
baskerville.source: rider correction on the corner map, 2026-09-08, remapped after GPX review

winton.mainStraight: 512m Kitome straight into the Motorsport News Esses
winton.note: Needed offset 2 until the out-and-back spur was cut from the GPX. The spur split the main straight in two, so the longest-straight heuristic picked the Falken straight instead; with the trace clean, geometry finds Turn 1 unaided.
winton.source: rider correction on the corner map, cross-checked against the official Winton map, 2026-09-08

mallala.mainStraight: Start/finish on the main straight; Turn 1 is the first right after that line
mallala.turn1: First right after start/finish, matching verifiedHands T2 left / T3 right
mallala.note: Rebuilt from mallala.ztracks. The source Start/Finish waypoint sits on the main straight, so the offset is 0.

queensland_raceway.mainStraight: 528m eastern straight into Turn 1; the 668m straight the detector picked is the western back straight
queensland_raceway.note: The source GPX carries the start/finish line as a 32m two-point segment lying perpendicular across the track, 1.5m from the trace's first point. That line agrees with the rider's mark, so the offset has two independent sources.
queensland_raceway.source: rider correction on the corner map, cross-checked against the start/finish line embedded in the source GPX, 2026-09-08

mac_park.mainStraight: 176m straight into the 177deg hairpin (detector's T4 exit -> T5 entry)
mac_park.turn1: 177deg hairpin, 16m minimum radius, matching the track guide's description of Turn 1
mac_park.supersedes: offset -1 derived from verifiedHands, which scored 10/10 on hands but placed start/finish in a sub-60m infield gap

smp_druitt.mainStraight: Shared Gardner pit straight into Turn 1; start/finish is the official Emtron start tick on that straight
smp_druitt.turn1: First left after the start/finish line, matching the Lapmeta Druitt map and Emtron C1
smp_druitt.note: Rebuilt from druittsmp.ztracks. The file's own Start/Finish mark sat inside a corner, so the waypoint is the nearest centreline point to the official Emtron start tick.

wanneroo.turn1: First right after the main straight, matching verifiedHands T1
wanneroo.note: Rebuilt from wannero.ztracks. The source Start/Finish mark is 64 m off the centreline, so numbering uses the longest straight.
